title: Session token sums keep undefined when every trace lacks a count
answers: session token total shows dash or zero incorrectly
how are missing token counts summed across traces
why does session total differ from sum of visible values
token usage aggregation with missing fields
body:
TraceCell.tsx:SessionTokensCell sums input_tokens, output_tokens and total_tokens field by field; a field stays undefined only if every trace lacks it, otherwise missing values count as 0.
TraceCell.tsx:TokenUsageCell renders the shared display for both the per-trace cell (TraceTokensCell) and the session cell, and shows the empty value when total_tokens is falsy.
Constraints: Changing the token display in TokenUsageCell changes both row and session headers together; changing the sum rule changes what a fully-unreported session shows (dash rather than 0). Usage comes from getTraceTokenUsage, which can return undefined and must be guarded with ?? {}.
applies: Token and other numeric usage aggregation in the traces table cells.
says: Session token summary shows a dash instead of zero when traces have no counts.
The total tokens column in the traces table displays zero for missing session data.
Aggregated session token usage displays empty when individual trace token counts are omitted.
Make the traces table session header display a dash when no tokens are recorded.
Session token counts do not match the sum of visible trace token values.
